column4: Pairing line for the cluster entry above, required by scripts/check-skip-ledger-engine-coverage.py (cleat#2158): engine-race.yml -- the only job that checks the test-go/engine key, 4-hourly off the per-PR trigger set -- runs with the same single-DSN (postgres-only) shape as the cluster job above, so TestWorkflowDefDefaultsToTheAuthExposureClass's mysql and mssql subtests skip there too. Identical regex to the cluster line, as the pairing check requires; not independently measured against a live engine-race.yml run (it is not a per-PR job), but the dialect gating is the same registeredBackends mechanism as the cluster line, which was measured.
